column6: Cibola County NM created from part of Valencia County (35061) effective 1981-06-19. Census 1980s page, verbatim; 1980 population of the created county was 30347. Parent FIPS confirmed 9/3/26 -- was flagged unverified in the 8/31 draft. Predates all outcome data.

La Paz County AZ created from part of Yuma County (04027) effective 1983-01-01. Census 1980s page, verbatim; 1980 population of the created county was 12557. Parent FIPS confirmed 9/3/26 -- was flagged unverified in the 8/31 draft. Predates all outcome data.

Washabaugh County SD merged into Jackson County SD, 1983. PROVENANCE ASYMMETRY: Dorn documents this; the Census substantial-changes page for the 1980s does NOT list it, most likely because it fell under the 200-person / 10-sq-mi threshold for 'substantial'. Kept because it is a plain merger and harmless, but do not describe it as Census-confirmed. Predates all outcome data.

South Boston independent city VA reverted to town status and merged into Halifax County, effective 1995-06-30. MISSING from the 8/31 draft; caught by Dorn and then confirmed against the Census 1990s page. Matters most of the 10: it lands at the start of the good-collision-data window Eyal identified (mid-90s/early-2000s).
Dade County FL renamed Miami-Dade County, same geography, new FIPS code, effective 1997-07-22.

Yellowstone National Park (Montana portion) deleted and divided between Gallatin County and Park County, effective 1997-11-07. A park administrative unit rather than a residential county, so population is expected to be near zero -- apply_fips_crosswalk logs the magnitude actually dropped rather than assuming it.
Clifton Forge independent city VA reverted to town status and merged into Alleghany County, effective 2001-07-01.

Broomfield County CO created from parts of Adams (08001), Boulder (08013), Jefferson (08059) and Weld (08123) counties, effective 2001-11-15. The ONLY split inside the analysis window. Pre-2001 the area had no separate population AND no separate collisions -- crashes were filed under the four parents -- so a back-apportioned denominator would produce a fake near-zero collision rate for two decades. Left NaN and flagged.
Bedford independent city VA changed to town status and merged into Bedford County, effective 2013-07-01.
Shannon County SD renamed Oglala Lakota County, same geography, new FIPS code, effective 2015-05-01.
